categories.main_business_segments: Hebei Sailhero Environmental Protection High-tech Co., Ltd. operates primarily in environmental monitoring, environmental management, and environmental governance services. Its business includes ecological environment monitoring systems, carbon emission monitoring and management services, ecological big data and decision support, natural ecological monitoring, operation and maintenance services, industrial pollution deep treatment, regional sewage treatment, socialized environmental testing, and new energy project development and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IoT, big data, cloud computing, AI, 5G, and advanced sensing technologies to build integrated environmental monitoring and management platforms. It develops proprietary monitoring equipment such as air quality continuous automatic monitoring systems, high spectral scanning imaging systems for water ecology, and advanced VOCs treatment technologies. The company emphasizes innovation in sensor miniaturization, grid-based monitoring, and AI-assisted ecological monitoring, supported by a strong R&D team and numerous patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government environmental protection agencies at various levels, industrial parks, enterprises requiring pollution control, and regional environmental management bodies. The company serves markets focused on air quality monitoring, water quality monitoring, pollution source control, carbon emission management, and ecological environment protection, primarily within China but also with some overseas operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province. It has subsidiaries and projects in multiple Chinese cities and provinces, and overseas subsidiaries primarily in the United States and Europe. Its international operations include environmental services and technology development in the US and the Netherlands.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hebei Sailhero operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing environmental monitoring equipment manufacturing, integrated environmental data services, consulting, and pollution treatment solutions. It also extends upstream into new energy project development and investment, integrating environmental technology with energy production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in environmental monitoring technologies, including portable high-precision particulate matter monitors, VOCs detection and treatment, ozone monitoring, methane remote sensing, and AI-assisted ecological monitoring systems. It focuses on digital transformation of environmental monitoring, ecological big data platforms, and integrated environmental governance solutions aligned with China's carbon neutrality and ecological civilization goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of environmental monitoring instruments and systems, operation and maintenance services, environmental consulting, and project-based engineering services. The company also earns income from new energy project development and investment, as well as government subsidies and grants related to environmental protection initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in China's environmental monitoring and governance industry, maintaining high market shares in conventional air monitoring and grid-based monitoring markets. It competes with other domestic environmental technology firms and benefits from its full-industry-chain service capabilities and technological innovation. The company is recognized as a leading player in ecological environment monitoring and integrated environmental services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 952.5 million RMB, a slight decrease of 1.44% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 152.4 million RMB, mainly due to increased impairment provisions. Total assets stood at about 2.06 billion RMB with shareholders' equity of approximately 1.63 billion RMB. The company has a large workforce exceeding 2,300 employees and continues to invest significantly in R&D, although profitability challenges persist.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive full-industry-chain environmental protection services, integrating advanced IoT and big data technologies to provide precise, real-time environmental monitoring and intelligent decision-making support. Its unique ecological big data platform ('Ecological Brain') enables unified planning and control of environmental governance, offering customers scientifically grounded pollution source identification and tailored remediation solutions. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio underpin its differentiated product offerings and service quality.
